newsitem.title: Belgium: Belgian Bel-20 index closes above 2,000 level.
newsitem.headline: Belgian Bel-20 index closes above 2,000 level.

text.p: 1540 GMT - The Brussels bourse's leading Bel-20 share index closed above the 2,000 level for the first time, setting its sixth consecutive all-time high. Dealers were mixed on whether the bourse could maintain these levels after the Dow .DJI saw profit-taking in easrly trading.
* Bel-20 .BFX closed up 0.70 percent to 2,005.37 with a heavy 3.08 billion francs volume of Belgian shares traded.
* Non-ferrous company Union Miniere gained 4.47 percent to 2,220 francs on the back of strong dollar.
